brand.name: Stripe
brand.summary: Stripe provides financial infrastructure for businesses to accept payments, build billing models, and manage money movement. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for online and in-person transactions, fraud prevention, and financial services, aiming to simplify and enhance economic growth for companies of all sizes. Stripe also supports startups with resources and programs to facilitate their growth.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: Stripe is a global financial infrastructure platform enabling businesses to accept payments, manage billing, and move money. They offer a wide array of tools from basic payment processing to complex financial services, catering to businesses from startups to large enterprises with a focus on growth and scalability.
